name: print-social-ai-social-media-automation-multi-colour-post-grid
title: Social Media Automation Post Grid
whatItIs: A pale grey board of nine portrait posts about social media automation in white, black, green, purple and yellow cards with bold sans headlines, icon rows, buttons, photos and play buttons.
whatItMeans: Alternating flat colour cards with the same type system make a feed feel varied yet consistent.
techniques: Flat colour backgrounds rotated across cards
Black pill buttons and round play icons
Small brand row at each card top

vocabulary.definition: Cycling background colours across a set of posts.
